title: Atlas launch replan

transcript.speaker: sam@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Recap first. On the 24th we moved GA from September 30 to October 14 in the atlas-launch thread, because ATL-212 didn't close. Today is to confirm that and plan for what happens if KeyGate slips again.

transcript.speaker: devon@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Latest from Victor: KeyGate says the signing-cert rotation fix ships October 9. That leaves us four days of testing before the 14th. Tight but doable.

transcript.speaker: elena@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Their last estimate also sounded confident. What's our leverage?

transcript.speaker: devon@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Victor is great but he's a partner SE, he doesn't control their roadmap. We have an exec sponsor on their side from the partnership deal. I haven't used that yet.

transcript.speaker: raj@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Use it. This week. Devon, escalate to their exec sponsor, I'll join the call if it helps.

transcript.speaker: devon@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Okay. I'll get it done by Thursday.

transcript.speaker: omar@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Globex update. Dana emailed me on the 26th. Paraphrasing: they can't roll out to 120 robots without SSO, and the renewal conversation gets harder every week this slips.

transcript.speaker: lena@northwind.dev
transcript.text: She wants something in writing. A timeline with dates and what we're doing if KeyGate doesn't deliver. Verbal reassurance isn't cutting it with her security team.

transcript.speaker: elena@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Then send it. Lena, can you have it out by next Monday, the 5th?

transcript.speaker: lena@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Yes, but I need Devon's input on the fallback before I commit to anything.

transcript.speaker: jordan@northwind.dev
transcript.text: On fallback: we could do OIDC directly against their IdP and skip KeyGate's SAML path. Not cheap. I'll put together an estimate by the 9th, same day KeyGate is supposed to ship.

transcript.speaker: kai@northwind.dev
transcript.text: If we go OIDC, the login UI mostly carries over. The admin config screen changes though.

transcript.speaker: raj@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Contingency question. If KeyGate misses the 9th, do we launch on the 14th without Enterprise SSO?

transcript.speaker: sam@northwind.dev
transcript.text: My proposal: yes, launch Standard on the 14th, Enterprise SSO follows as soon as it's ready. Globex gets early access to SSO the moment it works.

transcript.speaker: elena@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Let's not decide that today. Revisit on the 9th when we know what KeyGate did.

transcript.speaker: sam@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Fine. I'll own launch comms for the 14th, blog post, customer email, in-app banner.

transcript.speaker: omar@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Quick one, is the launch plan doc on the wiki updated? Dana's team has a link to it.

transcript.speaker: sam@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Uh. It still says September 30. I'll fix it.

transcript.speaker: jordan@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Can we make that an action item?

transcript.speaker: sam@northwind.dev
transcript.text: It's on my list with the comms, I'll bundle it. Moving on, we're over time.

summary: Confirmed the Atlas GA move from 2026-09-30 to 2026-10-14 (decided in #atlas-launch on 2026-09-24) because ATL-212 is still blocked on KeyGate's SAML metadata signing-cert rotation bug. KeyGate's current fix ETA is 2026-10-09. Globex (Dana Whitfield) escalated on 2026-09-26 and wants a written SSO timeline. Agreed to escalate to KeyGate's exec sponsor, estimate an OIDC fallback, and revisit launching Standard-only on 2026-10-09. Omar noted docs/atlas-launch-plan.md still says 2026-09-30; no separate action item was recorded and the doc was not updated.
decisions: Decision on launching without Enterprise SSO deferred to 2026-10-09.

action_items.text: Escalate to the KeyGate exec sponsor
Send Globex a written SSO timeline
